title: Goldreich–Levin failure budget
statement: For every natural number $n$ and rational threshold $\tau$ with $0<\tau\le 1$, let $A=\lceil4/\tau^2\rceil$ and $\delta=1/[40(n+1)(A+1)]$. Then $n\cdot(2A)\cdot\delta\le 1/20$.
